prompt: Rewrite snippets/wishlist-count.liquid so it renders the header wishlist link with an item count badge. All variables are top-level and are always supplied, but some may be null. Inputs: - items: array or null. Null means an empty list. Every element is an object that always has two keys: - title: string. Not used in the output. - available: boolean or null. Null means false. - show_unavailable: boolean or null. Null means false. - cap: integer (always at least 1) or null. Null means 99. - label: string or null. Rules: 1. Compute TOTAL: - When show_unavailable is true, TOTAL is the number of elements in items. - Otherwise, TOTAL is the number of elements whose available is exactly true. 2. Compute TEXT: strip leading and trailing whitespace from label. If the result is empty, or label is null, TEXT is "Wishlist". TEXT is always output HTML-escaped with the escape filter. 3. Compute NOUN: "item" when TOTAL is exactly 1, otherwise "items". This includes 0, which uses "items". 4. Compute SHOWN: - When TOTAL is greater than the cap, SHOWN is the cap followed by "+" (for example "5+"). - Otherwise, SHOWN is TOTAL. 5. Choose CLASSES: "wishlist wishlist--empty" when TOTAL is 0, otherwise "wishlist". 6. Output exactly one anchor, with no whitespace or newlines anywhere before, after or between the tags: TEXTBADGE - The aria-label always uses the real, uncapped TOTAL. - BADGE is SHOWN when TOTAL is greater than 0. - BADGE is nothing when TOTAL is 0. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/wishlist-count.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
